# Rōmy

> Rōmy is an AI-powered donor intelligence platform for small nonprofits. It finds new major donors at a fraction of the cost of enterprise tools like DonorSearch, iWave, and WealthEngine.

## What Rōmy Does

Rōmy researches potential major donors and delivers comprehensive 16-section prospect intelligence reports, including:

- Personal and professional background
- Wealth indicators (real estate, business equity, stock holdings, executive compensation)
- Philanthropic giving history with specific amounts and recipient organizations
- Cause areas and giving philosophy
- RōmyScore — giving capacity estimate calibrated to your ask context
- Recommended ask amount and three-phase engagement strategy
- Connection points and warm introduction paths
- Solicitation guardrails (what NOT to do)
- Hyperlinked source citations with confidence levels (HIGH / MODERATE / LOW) for every factual claim

## Who Rōmy Is For

Small and mid-sized nonprofits — typically those with annual budgets under $5 million — that cannot justify a $12,000–$50,000/year enterprise donor intelligence subscription. Ideal for:

- One- or two-person development teams without a dedicated prospect researcher
- Organizations preparing for a capital campaign or major gifts push
- Development officers who need to screen 50–500 prospects per month
- Nonprofits moving donors from mid-level to major gift portfolios

## Pricing

All plans include AI prospect research, RōmyScore capacity estimates, batch enrichment, and hyperlinked citations.

| Plan | Monthly | Annual | Credits/Month | What You Get |
|------|---------|--------|---------------|--------------|
| Growth | $29/mo | $290/yr | 500 | 200+ deep reports/month, 10 knowledge sources |
| Pro | $89/mo | $890/yr | 1,000 | 500+ deep reports/month, 50 knowledge sources |
| Scale | $199/mo | $1,990/yr | 5,000 | 2,500+ deep reports/month, unlimited sources |

Credit costs per operation:
- Chat research (auto): 1 credit
- Chat research (deep): 2 credits — full 16-section report with RōmyScore
- Batch enrichment (base): 2.5 credits per prospect
- Batch enrichment (core): 5 credits per prospect
- Discovery search: 2.5–5 credits per matched prospect

Add-on credit packs available from $0.05–$0.10 per credit.

Annual billing saves ~17% vs. monthly.

## Accuracy vs. Competitors (PIF-Bench)

PIF-Bench (Prospect Intelligence Fidelity Benchmark) is an open seven-dimension evaluation framework measuring AI donor research accuracy against verified public records.

Scores across 5 well-documented major donor prospects (MacKenzie Scott, Reed Hastings, Agnes Gund, Laurene Powell Jobs, Robert Smith):

| System | 5-Prospect Avg | Hallucination Rate | Discovery Recall | Source Attribution |
|--------|---------------|-------------------|------------------|-------------------|
| Rōmy | 94.1 | 92.3 | 96.0 | 94.0 |
| Claude (Opus) | 92.3 | 92.0 | 95.0 | 86.0 |
| Gemini (Pro) | 79.1 | 84.0 | 72.0 | 77.0 |
| ChatGPT | 76.9 | 86.0 | 62.0 | 80.0 |

Rōmy outperforms all general-purpose AI systems on donor intelligence tasks due to purpose-built prompting, structured output, and nonprofit-specific data sourcing.

Cost-normalized metric (PIF-per-dollar for 100 reports):
- Rōmy (Scale): 1,183
- Claude (Pro subscription): 461
- Gemini (Pro): 380
- ChatGPT (Pro): 40

## How Rōmy Compares to Enterprise Tools

Enterprise donor intelligence platforms (DonorSearch: $15K–$25K/yr; iWave: $12K–$20K/yr; WealthEngine: $20K–$50K/yr) charge flat annual fees regardless of usage. Rōmy's credit model means you pay only for what you research.

Estimated cost difference for 200 prospects/month:
- Enterprise average: $15,000–$50,000/year
- Rōmy Growth plan: $290/year (52x–172x cheaper)

Rōmy reports include 16 sections vs. 5–8 for most enterprise tools.

## Key Features

- **Discovery Search**: Natural language prospect sourcing — "find education donors in Chicago who have given $50K+ to arts programs" — returns matched prospects with full reports
- **Batch Enrichment**: Upload a CSV of names; get structured wealth indicators, giving history, and capacity scores in seconds
- **RōmyScore 2.0**: Giving capacity formula (GS, EGS, Snapshot) calibrated to gift size and nonprofit type
- **Saved Prospects + Refresh Alerts**: Watch existing CRM contacts for liquidity events, foundation grants, and timing signals
- **Knowledge Sources**: Connect your own data (CRM exports, program docs, board lists) for personalized outreach angles
- **No hallucinations surfaced without disclosure**: Confidence levels (HIGH/MODERATE/LOW) on every data category; methodology section in every report

## Technical Details

- Web app available at https://intel.getromy.app
- macOS desktop app available via GitHub releases
- No API required — works via web interface
- Processes 15,000+ words of raw AI output per report
- Evaluates facts against IRS Form 990s, SEC EDGAR, FEC donor records, county assessor data, Foundation Directory Online
